problem_statement: A recursive mutex API must provide a function named rmutex_lock_max with signature int rmutex_lock_max(rmutex_t *rmutex, uint16_t max). It locks a recursive mutex in a blocking way: if another thread holds the mutex, it waits until the mutex becomes available. A call returns 1 when it acquires the mutex and leaves it locked, including when the calling thread already owns the mutex but the nesting limit has not been reached. It returns 0 without acquiring it when the calling thread already owns the mutex and the maximum number of nested acquisitions by that owner is reached. The max argument is the maximum number of nested acquisitions by the owner and is assumed to be greater than 0.
